overview_description.description:
Incredible Health is the largest AI company powering healthcare hiring, with over 1.5 million U.S. healthcare workers and over 1,500 healthcare employers. AI voice agents, Gale and Lyn, transform the healthcare hiring experience and economics of healthcare hiring, with the average hospital reducing hiring times from 90 days to under 20 for permanent nurses.

Healthcare workers use Incredible Health's marketplace to discover opportunities, advance their careers, and land their dream jobs. Employers use the healthcare hiring solutions to gain a competitive edge, save millions in overtime, premium labor, and HR costs, and deliver consistent care to their communities. Powered by millions of marketplace datapoints and interactions, Incredible Health’s AI technology is continuously trained and refined to deliver fast, personalized, and reliable results. Co-founded by MD and Wharton alum, Iman Abuzeid, and MIT alum from a family of nurses, Rome Portlock, Incredible Health is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, and operates nationally.

product.name: Incredible Health Marketplace
product.description: A healthcare hiring marketplace that matches nurses, technicians, and other healthcare professionals with permanent roles at healthcare employers using worker profiles, job listings, and AI-powered recommendations.

product.name: Lyn AI Voice Interview Agent
product.description: An AI voice agent for healthcare employers that conducts phone interviews, verifies candidate specialties, explains employer differentiators, and produces interview summaries for recruiters.

product.name: Gale AI Career Partner
product.description: An AI career assistant for healthcare professionals that supports resume refinement, interview preparation, and decisions about job-search and career next steps.

product.name: Healthcare Employer Recruiting Services
product.description: Recruiting services for healthcare employers that combine candidate outreach, hiring guidance, workforce benchmarking, and dedicated support to fill permanent clinical roles.

product.name: Healthcare Career Education
product.description: An online education service offering nursing continuing education units (CEUs) to help nurses meet professional and licensing requirements.

product.name: Nurse Advice Community
product.description: An online community where nurses ask questions, exchange answers, and share practical advice about job searches, clinical careers, and professional development.
